## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `7dabaf6aefa880fda27fc8ad574ac5cf064cd808`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/area-lease.md + none

Read, not reviewed (outside the diff): `landing-operations.md`, AGENTS.md rule 14, `scripts/pm/check-governed-merges.mjs` (register), `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` (ceiling row and discipline header).

### ① Derived judgments

- Diff: one file, +3/−4, 60 → 59 lines, merge-base `0ac112fc`. The file list and the net diff agree with the card's single home.
- Card acceptance 1 holds on the head: `本区通过复审` has 0 hits under `.claude`, `AGENTS.md`, `docs` and `scripts/pm`. `授权行` survives only at area-lease.md L26 and L28. No recogniser, lint or self-test pins the old step-3 text. The only other mention is a code comment in the ratchet (see S1).
- Card scope line holds: the 席线程 line 「审批人批准后的 Tier H PR 你可以自主落地」 is byte-identical (L27). Only the 区线程 line is gone, and the step header now names 席线程 only, as card change 2 orders.
- Card change 3 is carried by L44 「受拒报原文」 together with L28 「区线程无授权行」: a refused landing reports the refusal text, and there is no area line left to name as the cause.
- Byte budget: edited lines measure 120 B (L26), 109 B (L28), 120 B (L44); no line of the file exceeds 120 B. No line was bought by a re-wrap; the count falls by exactly the deleted line.
- No issue number, PR number or comment id in the operative text of the three edited lines.
- Tier: `.claude/**` is the `claude-tree` row, `GOVERNED_TIER_S` for objectstack; the PR has no other path, so the PR is Tier S.
- Check-runs on this sha (46): 12 success, 25 skipped, 0 failed, 9 still in progress at review time — `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Lint · ESLint`, `Lint · CI, release & engine gates`, `Lint · docs & code guards`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Type Check · workspace`, `Type Check · source gates`, `Type Check · consumer gates`, `Type Check · debt ledger`. `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards`, `Check Changeset` and `Check PR Size` are success. The ratchet and id-lint verdicts ride `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, which is PENDING: this record does not stand in for it, and rule 14 still requires every check green before the seat lands.

### ② Semver level

none. Internal PM tooling text under `.claude/**`; nothing published. `skip-changeset` is correct. Clause-②: no.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Governed surface, Tier S (`.claude/**`): lands by the owning seat through the queue on this record plus all-green checks. No maintainer approval is owed; no Tier H path is in the diff.
- No landing widening. L44 keeps the 「非受管 PR」 qualifier and still opens with the `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr N` read; L45 (受管面与超 3,000 行 PR 区 ⛔ 不落,交席位) is untouched; L28 keeps 「⛔ 不改 AGENTS.md 第 14 条的落地档」.
- File surface: the claim's surface is respected; `landing-operations.md` is untouched, which the claim allowed.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix.

- Step 3 reads coherently. 「每条新席线程」 plus the single 席线程 bullet says only what the card allows, and the appended 「区线程无授权行」 is a true bound: nothing in `landing-operations.md` or AGENTS.md rule 14 conditions an area thread's landing of a non-governed PASS PR on a per-thread maintainer line. It states an absence and grants nothing.
- L44 states the existing rules truthfully. 「非受管 PR 照 landing-operations.md 自落」 is the old sentence compressed, the subject 区 carried from the first clause. 「受拒报原文」 agrees with `landing-operations.md` L64 (落地遭分类器拒 ⇒ 停手、报维护者、卡上记命令与拒因;⛔ 不换拼法) and with card change 3; because the same clause cites `landing-operations.md`, the stop and the no-workaround ban still govern.
- S1 (should-fix) — the ratchet row for area-lease.md stays at 60 against a landed 59. The gate does not red on headroom, so this head is not blocked, but the ratchet's own convention is 「landed count, headroom 0」 on every row, and headroom 1 is one line of unruled growth the next edit can take without a ruling. The row comment at `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` L1379 also still says 「the maintainer's authorising line per thread」, which this PR makes stale. Discharge in a follow-up PR: lower the row 60 → 59 and correct the comment. Not in this PR.
- N1 (nit) — 「受拒报原文」 names no destination; the card says 「in its thread」 and L64 says the maintainer and the card. The citation covers it; no change asked.

Answers to the dev's open questions:

1. Ratchet ceiling: option A, as a follow-up PR by the seat (S1). `scripts/pm/**` is not a governed surface, so that PR lands on the ordinary path; widening this PR would move the head and re-owe this review for a row the card's file surface excludes. Lowering is always legitimate under the ratchet's discipline and needs no ruling.
2. The 「若判 Tier H 则需您批准」 hedge: the reading is Tier S, from the register and the file list. No maintainer approval or merge is needed; the card body's 「需要您亲手合并」 predates that reading and is likewise superseded by rule 14's Tier S path. The tree is judged, not the PR body, so this is no finding: option B, leave it.

The comment's lines are 62–90 B.

No Tier H path.
- Check-runs on this sha (43): 23 success, 19 skipped, 0 failed, 1 still in progress at review time — `Test Core (1/8)` (the aggregate `Test Core` verdict is therefore not yet in). `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` (ratchet and id-lint), `Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests`, `Lint · repo & tooling gates`, `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `PR-body guards` and `Check PR Size` are success. Rule 14 still requires every check green before the seat lands.

### ② Semver level

none. Internal PM tooling text under `.claude/**` and one row of an internal gate script; nothing published. `skip-changeset` is correct. Clause-②: no.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Governed surface, Tier S (`.claude/**`): lands by the owning seat through the queue on this record plus all-green checks. The second path is ungoverned and does not change the tier. No maintainer approval is owed.
- No landing widening: area-lease.md is unchanged since the prior record, where L44, L45 and L28 were judged.
- File surface: the widening to the ratchet script is on record in claim amendment 6897134113, limited to the one row and its comment, and the diff stays inside it.

No must-fix, no should-fix.

- S1 — CLOSED. The row is lowered 60 → 59 to the landed count (headroom 0, the convention of every other row), and the stale 「authorising line per thread」 comment is corrected. I had asked for a follow-up PR; closing it here under the claim amendment is equally sound, since the path is ungoverned and the tier does not move. The gate that reads the row, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, is green on this head.
- area-lease.md: judgments of 6897124418 stand on identical bytes. Step 3 names only the 席线程 line, 「区线程无授权行」 is a true bound that grants nothing, and L44 restates `landing-operations.md` and rule 14 without widening what an area thread may land.
- The ratchet row agrees with the contract it enforces: ceiling equals the file's line count, lowered only, no other row touched.
- N1 (nit) — carried, unchanged: 「受拒报原文」 names no destination; the `landing-operations.md` citation covers it. No change asked.

The dev's open questions: 1 is discharged by this head (S1 closed). 2 stands as answered: the reading is Tier S, no maintainer approval is needed, and the PR-body hedge is no tree finding.
